title: INC: Console login errors
author: Miles Thornton
content:
h1. INC: Console login errors

Status: resolved.

h1. Window
2026-07-21 08:15 UTC to 2026-07-21 09:02 UTC.

h1. Impact
Some users saw an error when signing in to the Console. API traffic, billing and payments were not affected.

h1. Resolution
A faulty identity-provider configuration was rolled back.
